# WG18 · Xác nhận đã chi (nhập mã chứng từ)

Group **WG · Tài chính PB02** · state · Next.js: **planned (U6)** (`/finance`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/finance/finance.js#bind`
- Finance PB02 is `prototype/finance/finance.js` (`PemaFinance.html()` + `mount(root)`), mounted inside the clinic shell; data comes from the Python API `finance_server.py` on 127.0.0.1:4174 with the headers `X-Pema-Role` and `X-Pema-Doctor`.
- `finance.js › bind()`: "Xác nhận đã chi" (`data-command="paid"`, shown on a closed period, WG13) asks `data.reference = prompt('Mã chứng từ chi')`; an empty answer or Cancel returns without a call. The code is sent as the payout voucher and the period becomes "Đã chi" (WG14).
- Inventory note: Native prompt() for the payout voucher code on a closed period (cancelled in the walk). Uses the closed period of WG13.
- Page key `finance` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"finance\"]"} → {"wait":".finance-workspace .metric, .finance-workspace .hero"} → {"click":"[data-finance-tab=\"work\"]"} → {"setValue":["#month","2026-08"]} → {"wait":"#export"} → {"ifVisible":["td:has-text(\"Chưa có lượt thủ thuật\")",[{"click":"#content details > summary"},{"wait":"#entry"},{"select":["#entry [name=patient]","P002"]},{"setValue":["#entry [name=date]","2026-08-10"]},{"select":["#entry [name=invoice]","WEB:P002:HD-0002"]},{"fill":["#entry [name=note]","Đã thực hiện, chờ đối soát"]},{"click":"#entry [type=submit]"},{"wait":"[data-command=\"approve\"]"}]]} → {"ifVisible":["[data-command=\"approve\"]",[{"click":"[data-command=\"approve\"]"},{"wait":"[data-command=\"close\"]"}]]} → {"ifVisible":["[data-command=\"close\"]",[{"dialog":"accept"},{"click":"[data-command=\"close\"]"},{"wait":"[data-command=\"paid\"]"}]]}; it must show "Xác nhận đã chi".

## Required text (keep verbatim)
- (no notice or empty state on this screen)

## Business rules
- Revenue ("Doanh số thực hiện") follows the completion date of the procedure; cash ("Thực thu") follows the receipt date; they are tracked separately.
- "Tiền thủ thuật đã duyệt": "Không phải lợi nhuận phòng khám".
- Native dialog: prompt() with the message "Mã chứng từ chi" (cancelled in the walk).

## Differences from the app design
- App H4 draws no payout step.

## Gotchas
- The tab content refreshes every 10 s (`setInterval`) unless an input has focus or the entry form is open; a pending form is never overwritten (`dirty` flag).
- Without the API the page shows "Chưa kết nối dữ liệu tài chính: <error>. Chạy python prototype/finance_server.py rồi thử lại." in `#error` (see WG9).
- Uses the closed period of WG13 (2026-08); the reach guards each set-up step so a rerun changes nothing.
- Canvas: page() with the finance header, period 2026-08 (see WG11); the prompt text "Mã chứng từ chi" is the exact manifest text.
